name: Softcat plc
research_rationale: Screen quality and aligned FY2026 FCF support the buy case, but rich valuation, margin compression, management cash dividend cover below 1× and GDT acquisition funding keep the research overlay at accumulate.

weekly_updates.summary:
No new RNS in the 7 Nov news batch; press continues to flag post-results share weakness and net margin ~7.6% vs ~9.1% YoY.  
Screen remains buy (7w persistent); filing-aligned FCF £150.9m now matches screen TTM, closing October’s FCF basis gap.  
Sep-2026 placing/retail offer materials for the GDT acquisition remain the main leverage overlay; Piotroski still 6/9 on leverage and gross margin.
